item.description: Read Chapter 2 of Srishti Khanda from the Shiva Purana and discover the eternal, beginningless, and infinite form of Lord Shiva, the Supreme Reality beyond creation, time, and the universe.

item.description: Read Chapter 3 of Srishti Khanda from the Shiva Purana and discover the divine manifestation of Adi Shakti, the eternal power of Lord Shiva through whom creation, preservation, and cosmic balance begin.

item.title: The Birth of Lord Brahma | Srishti Khanda | Rudra Samhita | Shiva Purana | Bholenath Dham
item.description: Read Chapter 4 of Srishti Khanda from the Shiva Purana and discover the sacred birth of Lord Brahma, the first creator, who emerges through the divine will of Lord Shiva and Adi Shakti to begin the work of creation.

item.title: The Creation of Lord Vishnu | Srishti Khanda | Rudra Samhita | Shiva Purana | Bholenath Dham
item.description: Read Chapter 5 of Srishti Khanda from the Shiva Purana and discover the divine creation of Lord Vishnu, the eternal preserver of the universe, who manifests through the supreme will of Lord Shiva to protect creation and uphold Dharma.

item.title: The Cosmic Order Established | Srishti Khanda | Shiva Purana | Bholenath Dham
item.description: Read Chapter 6 of Srishti Khanda from the Shiva Purana and discover how Lord Shiva established the divine cosmic order, assigning sacred responsibilities to Brahma, Vishnu, the gods, the elements, and all creation according to eternal Dharma.

item.title: The Origin of Time and the Yugas | Srishti Khanda | Shiva Purana | Bholenath Dham
item.description: Read Chapter 7 of Srishti Khanda from the Shiva Purana and discover the divine origin of Time (Kala), the eternal cycle of the Four Yugas, and how Lord Shiva established the cosmic rhythm that governs creation, Dharma, and spiritual evolution.

item.title: The Creation of the Gods and Sages | Srishti Khanda | Shiva Purana | Bholenath Dham
item.description: Read Chapter 8 of Srishti Khanda from the Shiva Purana and discover how Lord Brahma, under the divine guidance of Lord Shiva, created the gods, the Seven Great Sages (Saptarishis), and celestial beings to preserve Dharma, divine wisdom, and the cosmic order.

item.title: The Divine Purpose of Creation | Srishti Khanda | Shiva Purana | Bholenath Dham
item.description: Read Chapter 9 of Srishti Khanda from the Shiva Purana and discover the divine purpose behind creation. Learn why Lord Shiva manifested the universe, the role of Karma, Maya, Dharma, free will, and how every soul is guided toward spiritual awakening and ultimate liberation (Moksha).

item.title: Srishti Khanda | Divine Creation and Cosmic Order | Rudra Samhita | Shiva Purana | Bholenath Dham
item.description: Read all 18 completed chapters of Srishti Khanda in English and Bengali. Explore Shiva and Shakti, Brahma and Vishnu, cosmic order, time and the Yugas, the higher and lower worlds, living beings, dharma, Prakriti and Purusha, creation and dissolution.

item.title: Yuddha Khanda | The Celestial Wars and Victory of Dharma | Rudra Samhita | Shiva Purana | Bholenath Dham
item.description: Read Yuddha Khanda from the Shiva Purana and explore the great celestial wars led by Lord Kumara, the defeat of powerful demons, the triumph of divine righteousness, and the restoration of cosmic order throughout the three worlds.
